entities.name: FAM161A
observations: The 659-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed Xenopus tropicalis FAM161A (UniProt B0BM24).
FAM161A is annotated as involved in ciliogenesis and localized to the cilium, basal body, centriole, and photoreceptor connecting cilium.
Human FAM161A homolog annotation supports cilium assembly and cilium organization; query contains Pfam FAM161A_B domain (residues 234–577).

entities.name: Cilium organization
observations: FAM161A has a UniProt GO annotation for cilium organization (GO:0044782); exact-match Xenopus evidence lists it as involved in ciliogenesis.
